items.title: File Widerspruch against the rehabilitation rejection
items.quote: Gegen den Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erhoben werden.
items.computation: The letter states it was posted (Versandt am) on Saturday, 21.11.2026, and itself sets the delivery rule: 'Der Bescheid gilt mit dem vierten Tag nach dem angegebenen Versandtag als bekannt gegeben' (deemed-delivery fiction of § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X, 4 days for letters posted since 2025, no weekend/holiday shift of this day itself). 21.11.2026 + 4 days = Wednesday, 25.11.2026 = date of Bekanntgabe. Under § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X i.V.m. § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month Widerspruch period starts the next day, 26.11.2026, and under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB ends one month later on the day with the same number as the triggering day: 25.12.2026. That day (Erster Weihnachtstag) is a public holiday nationwide, and the following days (26.12. Zweiter Weihnachtstag/Saturday, 27.12. Sunday) are also non-business days, so under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X the deadline moves to the next business day: Monday, 28.12.2026.

warnings: The letter's printed 'Datum des Bescheids' (18.11.2026) is earlier than the 'Versandt am' date it also prints (Samstag, 21.11.2026); the deadline above was computed from the stated Versandtag, as the letter's own delivery-fiction clause refers to it, not from the earlier Bescheiddatum.

The sender's seat (Rentenweg 8, 35394 Mustergießen) appears to be in Hessen, so Hessian public holidays were used for the final deadline rather than NRW's, as instructed when the relevant office sits in another Land.

No concrete figures, decision reasoning details, or case officer name are given beyond the standard rejection text; this is an informational rejection with no payment or further action required other than the optional Widerspruch.
